project_type: Spring Boot 2.5.4 REST API (hexagonal architecture) simulating a small bank: user registration, wallet creation, deposits, wallet view, transfers.
language: Java (source/target level compatible with Java 11; project written for JDK 8-11 era)
build_system: Gradle via wrapper (./gradlew, Gradle 6.8.3). Uses legacy 'testCompile'/'testImplementation' DSL and 'io.spring.dependency-management'. NOTE: the wrapper requires downloading gradle-6.8.3-all.zip which is NOT available in this sandbox.
test_framework: JUnit 4.12 with SpringRunner + Mockito. Controller tests use MockMvcBuilders.standaloneSetup(...) (see src/test/java/es/jguimar/tinybankAPI/adapter/rest/UserControllerTest.java and WalletControllerTest.java). standaloneSetup means any @RestControllerAdvice must be explicitly registered via .setControllerAdvice(...) for the advice to take effect in tests.
build_command: ./gradlew build  (run from tiny-bank/). BLOCKED in sandbox - no Gradle distribution and no dependency cache. Use host-based javac/AST validation instead; real build/test must run in an environment with network access.
test_command: ./gradlew test  (run from tiny-bank/). BLOCKED in sandbox for the same reason.
verification_instructions: Preferred (needs network): from tiny-bank/, run './gradlew test' with JAVA_HOME pointing at a JDK 11 (available at /root/.local/share/mise/installs/java/11.0.2). In this sandbox that fails at the wrapper download step, so verification falls back to: (1) confirm every changed/added .java file is syntactically valid Java, (2) confirm the new @RestControllerAdvice references only exception types and Spring classes already on the classpath, (3) confirm existing tests' expectations (isBadRequest for missing fields, isConflict for ResourceExistsException, isNotFound for ResourceNotFoundException) remain satisfiable, (4) confirm new tests register the advice via standaloneSetup(...).setControllerAdvice(new GlobalExceptionHandler()).
snapshot_or_generated_files: MapStruct generates UserMapperImpl.java / WalletMapperImpl.java into src/main/generated/ at compile time. These are checked in but regenerated by the annotationProcessor during build. Do not hand-edit them.
setup_instructions: JDK 11 is at /root/.local/share/mise/installs/java/11.0.2. Set JAVA_HOME to it and PATH accordingly. gradlew needs 'chmod +x gradlew'. A Gradle 6.8.3 distribution and Maven Central access are required for a real build but are unavailable in this sandbox.
environment_constraints: NETWORK EFFECTIVELY INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: squid proxy returns 403 for services.gradle.org, repo1.maven.org, repo.maven.apache.org, plugins.gradle.org. The Gradle 6.8.3 wrapper dist is only a 0-byte .part file, and there is NO cached Maven/Gradle dependency store (no spring/junit/mockito jars anywhere on disk). Therefore './gradlew build' and './gradlew test' CANNOT run here. A system Gradle 8.14.5 exists but is incompatible with this project's Gradle-6 build script (removed testCompile) and still lacks dependencies. Java 25 is the default JDK but Gradle 6.8.3 only supports up to Java 15; JDK 11 must be used for any real build. Implementation on disk is fully feasible; runtime verification must be deferred to a networked environment.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md/AGENTS.md/steering files exist. Follow existing code conventions: Lombok annotations, constructor injection via @AllArgsConstructor, hexagonal layering (adapter/application/domain/infrastructure). Custom exceptions live in infrastructure/exception.
key_patterns: Controllers implement inbound 'web' port interfaces (UserWeb, WalletWeb) that carry the @RequestMapping/@ApiResponses annotations. Endpoints: POST /user, POST /wallet, PUT /wallet/{id}/money, GET /wallet/{id}, POST /wallet/money-tranfer. Current error handling is ad-hoc per-method try/catch throwing bare ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.X) with NO body, NO logging, NO message. Custom exceptions ResourceNotFoundException and ResourceExistsException both extend Exception with an empty body (no message constructor). Services throw these: CreateUserService.create -> ResourceExistsException; WalletService.putMoney/showWallet/transferMoney -> ResourceNotFoundException. Bean Validation (@Valid + @NotEmpty/@NotNull) on request DTOs produces MethodArgumentNotValidException on bad input (existing tests assert 400). spring-security-core is on the classpath (AccessDeniedException / AuthenticationException available) though no endpoint currently throws them.
directory_structure: src/main/java/es/jguimar/tinybankAPI/ contains: adapter/rest (controllers, dto, transform mappers), adapter/mongo (repos), application/port (inbound/outbound interfaces), application/service, application/usecase, domain/model (User, Wallet), infrastructure/configuration (Swagger, EmbeddedMongo) and infrastructure/exception (custom exceptions). Tests mirror this under src/test/java. Generated MapStruct impls under src/main/generated.
